consolidation_opportunities.title: Skill CRUD Operations - Basic Flow
consolidation_opportunities.resulting_test_name: Skill CRUD - Create, Edit, Navigate, and Field Validation
consolidation_opportunities.rationale: These tests cover sequential CRUD operations that naturally flow together: viewing list, creating with validation, editing fields, and navigation. They can be combined into a single end-to-end workflow.
consolidation_opportunities.consolidated_steps: 1. View skills list (card view) → 2. Create skill with mandatory field validation → 3. Edit name/description/instructions → 4. Navigate using back button → 5. Verify all changes persist
consolidation_opportunities.risks: Lower granularity for debugging specific validation failures

consolidation_opportunities.title: Skill Tagging - Complete Flow
consolidation_opportunities.resulting_test_name: Skill Tagging - Add, Remove, and Multiple Tags
consolidation_opportunities.rationale: Both tests cover tag management. They test the same functionality at different scales (single vs multiple tags). Can be merged into one comprehensive tagging test.
consolidation_opportunities.consolidated_steps: 1. Create skill → 2. Add single tag → 3. Verify persistence → 4. Add multiple tags on creation → 5. Add tags after creation → 6. Remove tag → 7. Verify all operations persist
consolidation_opportunities.risks: Minimal - tag operations are simple and can be tested together

consolidation_opportunities.title: Skill Invocation - Explicit and Autonomous Coexistence
consolidation_opportunities.resulting_test_name: Skill Invocation - Explicit, Autonomous, and Backward Compatibility
consolidation_opportunities.rationale: ELITEA-1735 and ELITEA-1736 test similar explicit/autonomous invocation in different contexts (agent vs conversation). ELITEA-2609 tests coexistence. These can be merged into a comprehensive invocation test.
consolidation_opportunities.consolidated_steps: 1. Create skills with distinct formatting → 2. Attach to agent → 3. Test explicit ~skill invocation → 4. Test autonomous context-based invocation → 5. Test coexistence (no double-injection) → 6. Verify in both agent and conversation contexts
consolidation_opportunities.risks: Test becomes longer; harder to isolate which invocation mechanism failed

consolidation_opportunities.title: Skill Publishing - Validation Scenarios
consolidation_opportunities.resulting_test_name: Skill Publishing - AI Validation (Blockers and Warnings)
consolidation_opportunities.rationale: Both test validation but with different outcomes (FAIL blockers vs WARN non-blockers). Can be combined into a single validation test covering both scenarios.
consolidation_opportunities.consolidated_steps: 1. Test FAIL scenarios (short content, placeholders, secrets) → 2. Verify publishing blocked → 3. Test WARN scenarios (generic name, no icon) → 4. Verify publishing allowed with warnings → 5. Complete publish with warnings
consolidation_opportunities.risks: Less focused on specific validation rules; may miss edge cases

consolidation_opportunities.title: Skill Icons - Complete Lifecycle
consolidation_opportunities.resulting_test_name: Skill Icons - Upload, Validation, Visibility, and Version Persistence
consolidation_opportunities.rationale: All three tests cover icon functionality. Can be merged into comprehensive icon test covering upload, validation, UI visibility, and versioning.
consolidation_opportunities.consolidated_steps: 1. Upload custom icon with format validation → 2. Test oversized file rejection → 3. Delete icon (revert to default) → 4. Verify visibility across UI (list, detail, agent, autocomplete) → 5. Create new version → 6. Verify icon persistence across versions
consolidation_opportunities.risks: Test becomes complex; icon bugs may be harder to isolate

consolidation_opportunities.title: Edit with AI - Complete Feature
consolidation_opportunities.resulting_test_name: Edit with AI - Happy Path, Navigation, and Error Handling
consolidation_opportunities.rationale: ELITEA-2611 tests happy path, ELITEA-2612 tests navigation and errors. These naturally flow together as a comprehensive Edit with AI test.
consolidation_opportunities.consolidated_steps: 1. Happy path: prompt input → generation → wizard → apply → 2. Navigation: back button preserves prompt → cancel preserves original → 3. Error handling: empty prompt validation → generation failure with retry
consolidation_opportunities.risks: Longer test; harder to identify which specific aspect failed

consolidation_opportunities.title: Skill Run Settings - Model and Context Configuration
consolidation_opportunities.resulting_test_name: Skill Run Settings - Model, Reasoning, Context, and Execution
consolidation_opportunities.rationale: All four tests cover different aspects of run_settings. Can be consolidated into a single comprehensive test of the run_settings feature.
consolidation_opportunities.consolidated_steps: 1. Configure fixed model with reasoning level and max tokens → 2. Save and verify persistence → 3. Verify test panel initializes with saved settings → 4. Execute skill and verify correct model used → 5. Test context toggle OFF → 6. Verify context excluded from execution
consolidation_opportunities.risks: Complex test covering multiple concerns; failure may be harder to diagnose

consolidation_opportunities.title: Skill Version Comparison - Display and Save
consolidation_opportunities.resulting_test_name: Skill Version Comparison - Modal, Display, and Independent Saves
consolidation_opportunities.rationale: Both tests cover the version comparison feature. ELITEA-3352 tests modal opening/layout, ELITEA-3353 tests data display and saves. Natural consolidation.
consolidation_opportunities.consolidated_steps: 1. Open comparison modal → 2. Verify side-by-side layout with correct version names → 3. Verify instructions display → 4. Edit and save Version 1 → 5. Verify Version 2 unchanged → 6. Edit and save Version 2 → 7. Verify independence → 8. Close/reopen to verify persistence
consolidation_opportunities.risks: Minimal - both tests cover same feature from different angles

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Skill instructions — Markdown edit and preview toggle
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Specific UI behavior (markdown toggle) that's distinct from basic CRUD. Should remain separate for focused testing of preview functionality.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: LLM model settings are configurable
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Basic model configuration test that's foundational. While related to run_settings tests, this covers the basic UI/UX of model selection, while 3825-3829 cover the deeper execution behavior.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Skill Publishing Wizard — Happy Path
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Critical happy path test for publishing. Should remain standalone as the baseline for all publishing tests.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Skill Publishing — Token Invalidation and TTL Expiration
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Security-critical test covering token behavior. Must remain separate due to its security implications and specific timing requirements (5-minute TTL).

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Skill Unpublish and Republish Lifecycle
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Complex lifecycle test covering unpublish → EntitySkillMapping preservation → republish → version coexistence. Too complex to merge with other publishing tests.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Agent with Skills Publishing Flow
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Agent-specific publishing with skill embedding. Distinct from skill publishing; covers different entity type.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Agent with Skills — Validation Attribution and Token Invalidation
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Complex test covering validation attribution to specific skills and token invalidation on skill changes. Security and validation critical; should remain separate.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Fork Skill End-to-End
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Comprehensive fork test covering complete workflow including lineage metadata. Should remain standalone as the primary fork test.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Fork Non-Base Skill Version
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Edge case covering version-specific forking. Important variation that should remain separate to ensure version normalization works correctly.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Skill Autonomous Invocation — Core Functionality
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: High priority test with SECURITY implications (unattached skills must never be invoked). Should remain separate for security validation.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Subagent Skills Isolation
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Tests critical isolation between parent and subagent skills. Security-relevant; must remain separate to verify no skill bleed.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Skill Version Selection Behavior
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Version-specific behavior test. Important for versioning correctness; should remain separate.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Edit with AI — Skill Permissions
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Permission-specific test (Admin/Editor/Viewer). Should remain separate as a focused permissions test.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Published Agent Version Cannot Be Modified
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Immutability test for published entities. Critical for data integrity; must remain separate.

tests_to_keep_separate.title: Verify agent uses its own model when running attached skill
tests_to_keep_separate.rationale: Critical test verifying agent precedence over skill settings. Important for backward compatibility; should remain separate from other run_settings tests.

exclude_candidates.title: Test panel does not create a new Chat conversation
exclude_candidates.rationale: Marked as DEPRECATED (status: deprecated). Behavior intentionally changed per EL-6922. Should be REMOVED from regression suite.

exclude_candidates.title: Skill Custom Icon Persistence on Save As Version
exclude_candidates.rationale: Priority: LOW. Icon persistence across versions is already tested in MERGE-005. This is a variation that adds minimal value to core regression.

exclude_candidates.title: Fork Non-Base Skill Version
exclude_candidates.rationale: Priority: MEDIUM (not high/critical). Edge case for forking non-base versions. Core fork functionality is covered by ELITEA-2602. This could be excluded if time is constrained.

high_risk_areas.rationale: Security-critical tests ensuring unattached skills cannot be invoked and subagent skills don't bleed. Must remain in core regression.
Token invalidation prevents unauthorized publishing. Security-critical; must remain separate and thorough.
Published versions must remain immutable to prevent unintended changes affecting production users.
Critical for backward compatibility - agents must use their own model, not skill settings.

consolidation_risks.description: Merging invocation tests may make it harder to isolate which specific invocation mechanism failed (explicit vs autonomous).
Run settings consolidation creates a complex test covering multiple concerns. Failure diagnosis may be more difficult.

implementation_recommendations.title: High-Value Consolidations (Review Carefully)
actions: Implement MERGE-003 (Skill Invocation) - review impact on debugging
Implement MERGE-007 (Run Settings) - ensure proper step isolation for debugging
